title: A tree can change
hook: A newly visible feature can change a proposed grouping.

knows: Fossils and models can supply evidence about the past.
doesNotKnow: The first view leaves the feature unknown; the second marks it for B and C. Under the stated single-origin and no-loss assumptions, this feature supports their grouping. Real trees require many traits and consideration of competing explanations.

misconception: A new character cannot change which grouping is supported.
objective: In a toy tree, a new feature arose once and was not lost. B and C have it; A does not. Which grouping is supported?
